name: SpareBank 1 Østfold Akershus
summary: SpareBank 1 Østfold Akershus operates as a savings bank that provides various banking products and services in Norway. It offers savings in funds; savings accounts; savings for children and retirement; and stocks and investment products. The company also provides mortgage, car, moving, consumer, vehicle, green, and transferring loans, as well as refinancing of mortgage and consumer debt; financing services, including overdrafts, leasing, business loans, bank guarantees, construction loans, growth guarantee schemes, operating credit for agriculture, factoring, and invoice sales.
